clues: In September 2026, its quantum software helped Fermilab cut design work from five months down to three weeks.
It donated a DGX GB300 system to the Naval Postgraduate School in July 2026.
It is building the Department of Energy's largest scientific supercomputer at Argonne National Laboratory.
